title: Roaming will not put doubt out
summary: Distance and novelty cannot do what the Guru must do. Bring the mind back to what is clear enough to keep.
takeaway: Bring the mind back to what is clear enough to keep.
lifeApplication: Before researching one more answer, repeat the clearest line you already trust until the breathing slows.

source.shortMeaning: Distance and novelty cannot do what the Guru must do.
source.lifeApplication: When escape feels spiritual, stay long enough for the real fire to be named.

evidence.coreClaim: Distance and novelty cannot do what the Guru must do.
evidence.turn: Hold onto this: doubt clears when the Guru's word outlasts wandering.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before researching one more answer, repeat the clearest line you already trust until the breathing slows.
